target: 尽力与不惜代价：保留原文限制
skill: 尽力与不惜代价：保留原文限制
q: A theatre team promises to spare no effort in rebuilding a damaged set, but will abandon the plan if the hall cannot be made safe. Which summary preserves the commitment?
o: The team must rebuild the set regardless of every consequence.
The team will make every effort within the stated safety limit.
The team will attempt repairs only if no serious work is needed.
The team treats its rebuilding goal as more important than safety.

exp.trans: 剧团承诺尽全力重建布景，但若礼堂不能达到安全条件就放弃。哪种概括保留了这一承诺？
exp.structure: spare no effort强调努力程度；but后的条件限制同样有效，不能被前半句抹去。
exp.meaning: 尽全力不自动等于不计后果。这里有明确安全限制，改写成at all costs或regardless of every consequence会超出原文。
exp.rest: regardless与more important than safety删除安全限制；no serious work把尽力反成只在不费力时才做。

target: at any cost / at all costs的强度
skill: at any cost / at all costs的强度
q: In a fictional competition, a captain says, "We must win at any cost." What strength does the phrase add to the statement?
o: Winning is desirable only while no extra expense is required.
Winning has already required a large but fixed payment.
Winning should be pursued whatever the price or difficulty.
Winning is guaranteed whenever the team makes a serious effort.

exp.trans: 在一个虚构比赛中，队长说必须不惜任何代价取胜。这个短语增加了什么强度？
exp.structure: at any cost与at all costs为惯用近义表达，限定追求目标时接受代价的态度，而不是宣布结果已经发生。
exp.meaning: 短语突出无论代价或困难的强烈取向，不只是努力程度；这类表达也可能有修辞色彩，不能因此保证一定成功。
exp.rest: no extra expense反向增加省钱限制；already...fixed payment混成已付高价；guaranteed把强烈意愿误成结果必然实现。

target: under no circumstances：强度与适用对象
skill: under no circumstances：强度与适用对象
q: A display rule states, "Under no circumstances may the original letter leave its case; staff may handle copies." Which statement preserves the rule?
o: Staff may never touch any copy or original item on display.
The original may leave its case when a visitor pays extra.
Copies must remain locked away just like the original letter.
The original must stay in its case, while copies may be handled.

exp.trans: 展陈规则说原信件在任何情况下都不得离开盒子，工作人员可拿取副本。哪句保留规则？
exp.structure: Under no circumstances的绝对限制指向original letter；分号后明确给copies不同权限。
exp.meaning: 强措辞并非一律错误：原文明确如此规定且对象范围一致时，应保留强度；不能扩大到所有副本。
exp.rest: never...any copy与copies locked扩大限制对象；pays extra增加原文没有的例外。

target: at a high cost与regardless of consequences分开
skill: at a high cost与regardless of consequences分开
q: A restoration was completed at a high cost. The report gives the final expense but says nothing about what losses the organizers would have accepted. What can be concluded?
o: The expense was substantial; unlimited acceptance is not stated.
The organizers promised to accept every possible harmful result.
The organizers were unwilling to make any serious financial effort.
The restoration would have continued regardless of the consequences.

exp.trans: 修复以高昂代价完成。报告给出最终费用，却没说组织者愿意接受哪些损失。能得出什么？
exp.structure: at a high cost描述已发生的代价大小；would have accepted是报告未提供的条件性态度。
exp.meaning: 高昂代价不等于无论什么代价都接受；不能把描述性成本事实改成at all costs式的无条件承诺。
exp.rest: every possible harmful result和regardless都补加无限接受的承诺；unwilling...any effort既无依据又与高额支出不符。

target: 作者论点与被引者归属理由
skill: 作者论点与被引者归属理由
q: A school official gives a cloth donor all the credit for new stage costumes because the donor owned the material. The reviewer writes: "But the fabric became useful costumes through the pupils' design and stitching." What is the reviewer emphasizing?
o: Ownership alone should determine who deserves all creative credit.
The pupils' work transformed the supplied cloth into useful items.
The donor must be blamed for every problem with the performance.
The official has already denied that any cloth was supplied.

exp.trans: 学校官员因布料属于捐赠者而把服装功劳全归给对方；评论者强调学生设计、缝制使布料成为可用服装。评论者强调什么？
exp.structure: official的理由是拥有材料；reviewer在But后另提出转化过程。需要归属主张，也要读出主张内容。
exp.meaning: 作者关注加工与设计贡献，而非只重述正式归属；这可迁移“持有资源”和“使之产生用途”的区别，不涉及原医疗协议。
exp.rest: Ownership alone重述官员观点；blamed...every problem换成无依据谴责；denied...supplied否认文中已承认的供给。

target: 资格认定与作者评价层次
skill: 资格认定与作者评价层次
q: An awards clerk says a novel is eligible because every form arrived on time. A critic replies, "However, timely paperwork tells us little about the imagination in the novel." Which view belongs to the critic?
o: The forms arrived too late for the novel to enter the award.
Administrative eligibility guarantees the novel's artistic merit.
Meeting an entry rule does not establish imaginative quality.
Every application rule should immediately be treated as invalid.

exp.trans: 奖项职员说小说按时交齐表格所以合资格；评论者说按时交表不能说明作品想象力。评论者观点是什么？
exp.structure: clerk处理资格，critic评论艺术质量；does not establish是对tells us little的限度相容改写。
exp.meaning: 进一步批评评价层次不足不等于否定所有程序规则；不能把被引用者的合规判断当作作者对质量的判断。
exp.rest: too late与按时到达相反；guarantees把资格升格成品质保证；every...invalid把局部不足扩成全面作废。

target: 认可合规同时提出进一步批评
skill: 认可合规同时提出进一步批评
q: An inspector certifies that a concert recording followed the licensing rules. A reviewer agrees that the licence matters but adds, "Yet musical clarity comes from the careful balance of instruments, not the certificate on the wall." What is the reviewer's further claim?
o: Legal permission proves that the recording must sound clear.
The inspector has rejected every part of the licensing scheme.
No legal permission is needed whenever the music sounds good.
Careful musical work explains clarity beyond formal permission.

exp.trans: 检查员确认录音符合许可规则；评论者认可许可的重要性，但强调声音清晰来自乐器平衡。进一步论点是什么？
exp.structure: agrees保留对许可的认可；but adds/Yet推进到声音质量的来源。not the certificate限制的是质量归因，不是许可合法性。
exp.meaning: 转折可增加分析层次，而非一概谴责或否定前文；区分法律许可和产生实际质量的工作。
exp.rest: proves...sound clear混淆合规与品质；inspector rejected错归观点；No legal permission把质量归因不当扩大为免除法律要求。

target: 作者补充条件与被引者单一指标
skill: 作者补充条件与被引者单一指标
q: A manager judges a delivery service by average speed. The columnist notes that parcels also need to arrive at the correct homes: "But an impressive time figure is of little use if the address is wrong." What is the columnist arguing?
o: Speed alone is insufficient; correct delivery also matters.
The manager has proved that no parcel can arrive quickly.
Any fast service must be worse than every slow service.
The company has formally abolished its speed measurements.

exp.trans: 经理用平均速度评估快递；专栏作者说地址错误时，漂亮的时间数字用处不大。作者主张什么？
exp.structure: manager的单一指标与columnist追加的准确性要求分开；if限定缺点出现的条件。
exp.meaning: 作者指出只看一个指标不足，未断言速度没价值，也未声称任何快服务都差。
exp.rest: manager...proved错归并添加绝对结论；any...every无依据比较所有服务；formally abolished虚构公司政策变化。

target: control / process：决定用途与执行处理
skill: control / process：决定用途与执行处理
q: A collection coordinator decides why recordings may be used and who may receive them. An assistant converts the files into searchable transcripts under those instructions. Which distinction fits the stated roles?
o: The coordinator sets the uses; the assistant performs conversion.
The assistant decides every purpose because conversion uses a computer.
The coordinator converts the files while the assistant sets the uses.
Neither person has any role until ownership of the files is sold.

exp.trans: 负责人决定录音用途与接收者；助理按指令把文件转成可搜索文本。怎样区分两者？
exp.structure: decides why/who给出用途与接收权限的决定；converts...under instructions给出实际处理步骤。
exp.meaning: 控制用途与执行处理不是同一个行为。这只是题干明确分工，不泛断法律责任全部归一方或处理方绝无责任。
exp.rest: assistant decides误由技术处理推出决定权；coordinator converts颠倒主体；until ownership sold添加交易前提。

target: 持有与处理创造的额外用途
skill: 持有与处理创造的额外用途
q: A gardening club stores labelled soil samples. Volunteers compare the samples' measurements and produce a map that helps members select suitable plants. What creates the map's additional usefulness in this account?
o: The samples remain inside boxes without being examined.
The labels prove that the club may ignore every measurement.
Combining and analysing measurements reveals useful patterns.
Owning a storage cupboard automatically supplies planting advice.

exp.trans: 园艺社团存放土样；志愿者比较测量结果并制作选植物用的地图。地图增加的用途来自什么？
exp.structure: compare...produce构成处理与成果的关系；stores只说明持有或保管材料，未独自形成地图信息。
exp.meaning: 此例中比较与分析创造额外用途；不由此推断原始材料在任何情况下毫无价值，或持有者没有任何权利。
exp.rest: without being examined否认处理步骤；ignore every measurement与制作地图的证据相反；automatically...advice把保管工具当成分析成果。

target: only when：必要条件不是充分保证
skill: only when：必要条件不是充分保证
q: A rehearsal room is unlocked only when a supervisor is present. Even then it may remain locked for maintenance. Which inference follows?
o: A supervisor's arrival always guarantees that the room is unlocked.
Without a supervisor, the room is not unlocked under this rule.
Maintenance requires the supervisor to leave before unlocking.
An unlocked room proves that maintenance has never occurred.

exp.trans: 排练室只有在主管在场时才开锁；即便主管在场，维修也可能使房间继续锁住。能推出什么？
exp.structure: only when P才Q：Q意味着P是必要条件；P不自动足以推出Q。题干另给维修限制确认这一点。
exp.meaning: 没有主管不能按该规则开锁；主管到场并不保证开锁。区分必要条件与充分条件，不能把only删掉。
exp.rest: always guarantees反转蕴含方向；requires...leave虚构维修规则；never occurred从当前开锁推断全部过去。

q: An exhibition issues a reproduction permit only when the owner has consented. A fee must also be paid. What does the consent clause establish?
o: Consent removes every other requirement for receiving a permit.
Any owner who consents must receive a permit without payment.
The fee replaces consent whenever the applicant can pay it.
A permit requires consent, while consent alone need not suffice.

exp.trans: 展览只有在所有者同意后才发复制许可，而且还需付费。同意这一条件说明什么？
exp.structure: permit only when consent表示有许可就须有同意；also列出另一个条件，不能由同意推出自动发证。
exp.meaning: 必要条件限制与“只要”不同；这里单独同意未必足够。同意和付费是并需条件，不能把两者当作可互相替代。
exp.rest: removes every other、without payment都删除费用条件；fee replaces consent把并需条件错当替代关系。

q: At noon the caretaker handed the studio keys over to a visiting stage crew, which must return them that evening. What happened?
o: The keys were given into the crew's temporary custody.
Ownership of the whole studio was permanently donated.
The keys were destroyed before the visiting crew arrived.
The crew was forbidden to receive or hold any studio key.

exp.trans: 中午管理员把钥匙交给客座剧组，约定当晚归还。发生了什么？
exp.structure: handed...over to给出移交对象；must return限定是临时交付，不是永久赠与整个场所。
exp.meaning: hand over是移交；具体转移的是保管、使用还是所有权需由语境确认，不能只看动词就断言永久出售。
exp.rest: whole studio...donated扩大对象和权利；destroyed捏造销毁；forbidden与已经移交相反。

q: An editor handed over the unfinished festival guide to a colleague who would complete the fact checks. Which paraphrase fits handed over?
o: Discarded the guide so that nobody could continue the work.
Declared the guide finished without asking anyone to check it.
Passed the guide to a colleague for the next stage of work.
Took every copy back from the colleague to stop the checking.

exp.trans: 编辑把未完成的节庆指南交给同事，由同事继续核实信息。handed over怎样改写？
exp.structure: to a colleague说明接收者；who would complete...说明后续任务；unfinished排除宣布完成。
exp.meaning: 这里是工作材料与后续处理的移交，不是丢弃、强行取回或宣布已经完成。
exp.rest: Discarded否认继续工作；Declared...finished与unfinished相反；Took...back颠倒移交方向。

q: A checklist designed for permanent museums is described as slightly maladapted to a one-day street exhibition. Several items still help, but its storage questions miss the event's main needs. What does slightly maladapted suggest?
o: The checklist is illegal in every kind of public exhibition.
The checklist is an imperfect fit for this particular setting.
Every item in the checklist is entirely useless for any event.
The checklist already addresses all needs of the street event.

exp.trans: 固定博物馆的清单用于一天的街头展览时略显不合适；部分项目仍有用，但储藏问题偏离主要需要。slightly maladapted说明什么？
exp.structure: slightly限制程度；to...限定适用环境；Several...still help保留局部价值。
exp.meaning: 不太适配此情境不等于完全无效、违法或所有场景不适用；必须保留程度和对象。
exp.rest: illegal无依据；Every...entirely useless抹去部分有用与slightly；all needs反转了不适配评价。

q: A workshop uses a ranking system built for solo races. The tutor calls it maladapted because it rewards speed while the workshop requires patient collaboration. What is the criticism?
o: The tutor has proved that no participant can work quickly.
The system was designed to measure illegal behaviour.
Every form of ranking is rejected for every possible purpose.
The system's criterion does not suit the workshop's purpose.

exp.trans: 工作坊沿用个人竞速排名，但活动需要耐心合作，导师说它不适配。批评是什么？
exp.structure: because引出评价与活动目标的错配；not suit对应maladapted，不是质疑排名在所有领域都没用。
exp.meaning: 从评价体系适合何种目标判断fit，不能把针对用途的批评扩大为全面废除。
exp.rest: no participant添加能力结论；illegal改变评价对象；Every form...every purpose把特定错配泛化。

target: tech giant：企业规模的比喻义
skill: tech giant：企业规模的比喻义
q: A report contrasts a two-person software start-up with a tech giant serving millions of customers across many markets. What does tech giant identify?
o: An unusually tall individual who repairs computers.
A machine whose physical height exceeds nearby buildings.
A large and influential business in the technology sector.
Any new company that has written its first computer program.

exp.trans: 报道把两人创业公司与服务数百万客户、跨多个市场的科技巨头比较。tech giant指什么？
exp.structure: tech限定行业；giant采用规模与影响力的比喻义，题干以客户和市场范围提供线索。
exp.meaning: 科技巨头指大型、有影响力的科技企业，不能字面解为高大的人或机器，也不等于任何初创企业。
exp.rest: tall individual与machine按体型直译；Any new company抹去规模与影响力限定。

q: A company is called a tech giant because of its scale and influence. The sentence makes no claim about its conduct. Which inference stays within that description?
o: The company has been proved to violate every relevant rule.
The company must control every smaller technology business.
The company is guaranteed to invent every important product.
The company is large; no verdict on its conduct is implied.

exp.trans: 一句话因规模与影响力称某公司为科技巨头，未评价行为。哪种推断不过界？
exp.structure: because仅给出规模和影响力的命名依据；no claim about conduct阻止从名称推出违法或道德评价。
exp.meaning: tech giant是企业类别与规模描述，本身不证明每种行为的好坏或普遍支配力。
exp.rest: every relevant rule、every smaller business、every important product都从规模添加了绝对化事实。
